GenericConnectorDescriptor.description: Hildr connector for parsing EDI-style payloads into Grenefolc Vartala canonical XML.

field.label: CLI Json
field.helpText: Process and parser behaviour switches only, for example { "cli": { "showProcessTrace": false, "presentationClass": "", "synonymStyle": "id", "maxOccurs": "none", "envelopeFilter": false } }.

field.label: Recognition Json
field.helpText: Optional recognition, routing, presentation, delimiter, and envelope override JSON. This is merged with Hildr's default recognition specification.

field.label: Model Xml
field.helpText: Optional model XML fallback. A document dynamic property named ddp_hildr_modelXml takes precedence when supplied.
